official_definition: Once per turn, you can look at the entire opposing Hand, and discard a card among them. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects. If that's a Magic card/card with Accel, you can immediately activate one of its Main/Flash effects as your effect. However, that card doesn't move from the Trash.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [True Plunder] or [True Plunder: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [True Plunder]", "give [True Plunder]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
